body.x: Pison contents(www.musicspray.net ) will showcase Music distribution platform 'Music spray' at 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show in Las vegas, U.S. that will be held from January 7th to 10th.

Pison contents created world-wide music distribution on-line platform for the very first in Korea, which offers world-wide service for selling and marketing the indie labels easily but quickly since they are weak at ensuring distribution channels.

Through the service, worldwide music artists or record companies can distribute their music to the domestic record stores including Melon, Bugs, Olleh, Mnet as well as global music stores such as iTunes, Amazon, Spotify, Deezer, Google Music, KKBOX, etc.

"We will provide record distribution service for indie labels and global musicians starting early next year"said the officials, " by securing a great quantity of labels, we will expand the service to the global market."

Pison contents is a direct distributor of main global records stores; iTunes, Amazon, Google, Spotify, Deezer, KKBOX, etc. The company develops and operates 'Music spray' and was selected as a company with a support of Small and medium business administration in 2011.

Since it opened domestic service in 2012, it has been distributing & aggregating 15,000 records of about 500 artistes. Pison contents will attempt to globalize its business intended for the artist in USA and Europe with the global service opening the early next year.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases more than 3,200 exhibitors, including manufacturers, developers and suppliers of consumer technology hardware, content, technology delivery systems and more; a conference and more than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries. The first CES took place in New York City in June of 1967. Since then, thousands of products have been announced at the yearly show in January.
